quote: Fish usually require all vitamins in the diet, however vitamin C and E, possibly the most important among all because of its powerful antioxidant property in fish health.
statement: 鱼类通常需要饮食中的所有维生素，但维生素C和E可能最重要，因为它们具有强大的抗氧化特性，对鱼类健康有益。
text_zh: 鱼类通常需要饮食中的所有维生素，但维生素C和E可能最重要，因为它们具有强大的抗氧化特性，对鱼类健康有益。
text_en: Fish generally require all vitamins in their diet, but vitamins C and E may be the most important because they have strong antioxidant properties that are beneficial to fish health.
outcome: 鱼体健康与抗氧化能力

quote:
The inclusion of
starch level above 10% of the diet dry matter, resulted in reduced utilization of feed in
Hippoglossus hippoglossus, salmon, and in Gadus morhua, all oblige carnivores
statement: 日粮干物质中淀粉水平超过10%导致大比目鱼、鲑鱼和鳕鱼等专性肉食性动物的饲料利用率降低。
text_zh: 日粮干物质中淀粉水平超过10%导致大比目鱼、鲑鱼和鳕鱼等专性肉食性动物的饲料利用率降低。
text_en: Starch levels exceeding 10% in dry matter of the diet lead to reduced feed utilization in obligate carnivorous animals such as halibut, salmon, and cod.

quote:
Several studies
suggested, that carnivores fish may maintain growth by compensating with high feed
intake when dietary starch account large part of the available energy
statement: 几项研究表明，当膳食淀粉占可用能量的大部分时，肉食性鱼类可能通过增加采食量来补偿以维持生长。
text_zh: 几项研究表明，当膳食淀粉占可用能量的大部分时，肉食性鱼类可能通过增加采食量来补偿以维持生长。
text_en: Several studies have shown that when dietary starch constitutes the majority of available energy, carnivorous fish may compensate by increasing feed intake to maintain growth.

quote: Probiotic application is a well-known method in aquaculture, are using to improve ponds water quality and surrounding environments.
statement: 益生菌应用是水产养殖中一种众所周知的方法，用于改善池塘水质和周围环境。
text_zh: 益生菌应用是水产养殖中一种众所周知的方法，用于改善池塘水质和周围环境。
text_en: Probiotic application is a well-known method in aquaculture used to improve pond water quality and the surrounding environment.

quote: The importance of probiotic increase more when a carnivorous fish like Chinese perch is amid to culture, and to maintain healthy water quality and ponds environments.
statement: 当养殖鳜鱼等肉食性鱼类时，益生菌的重要性增加，以维持健康的水质和池塘环境。
text_zh: 当养殖鳜鱼等肉食性鱼类时，益生菌的重要性增加，以维持健康的水质和池塘环境。
text_en: When farming carnivorous fish such as mandarin fish, the importance of probiotics increases to maintain healthy water quality and pond environment.

quote: Nitrobacteria and Photosynthetic bacteria (PSB) were applied (10 plants per square meter) into Chinese perch culture pool with a volume of 15m2 × 35m2 × 2.5m (length × width × height).
statement: 硝化细菌和光合细菌（PSB）被施用于鳜鱼养殖池中，用量为每平方米10株。
text_zh: 硝化细菌和光合细菌（PSB）被施用于鳜鱼养殖池中，用量为每平方米10株。
text_en: Nitrifying bacteria and photosynthetic bacteria (PSB) were applied to mandarin fish aquaculture ponds at a dosage of 10 strains per square meter.

quote: The result showed that the pH in Nitrobacteria and PSB applied group were lower than the control group, Nitrite, (NH4+-N), TP, and TN were also significantly lower in both experimental group than the control group.
statement: 结果显示，施用硝化细菌和PSB组的pH值低于对照组，亚硝酸盐、铵态氮、总磷和总氮在两个实验组中也显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 结果显示，施用硝化细菌和PSB组的pH值低于对照组，亚硝酸盐、铵态氮、总磷和总氮在两个实验组中也显著低于对照组。
text_en: The results showed that the pH value in the groups treated with nitrifying bacteria and PSB was lower than that in the control group, and nitrite, ammonium nitrogen, total phosphorus, and total nitrogen were also significantly lower in the two experimental groups than in the control group.

quote: in some studies , like in Atlantic salmon, the inclusion of high lipids level of 38% or 47% showed a better growth performance than low lipids level of 31% (Hemre and Sandnes 1999)
statement: 在大西洋鲑的研究中，日粮脂质水平为38%或47%时的生长性能优于31%时。
text_zh: 在大西洋鲑的研究中，日粮脂质水平为38%或47%时的生长性能优于31%时。
text_en: In studies on Atlantic salmon, growth performance was better at dietary lipid levels of 38% or 47% than at 31%.

quote: Generally, there are two most commonly signs of essential fatty acids are known, one is poor growth of fish and the second is poor feed efficiency in fish (Sargent 1989)
statement: 必需脂肪酸缺乏的两个最常见迹象是鱼类生长不良和饲料效率低下。
text_zh: 必需脂肪酸缺乏的两个最常见迹象是鱼类生长不良和饲料效率低下。
text_en: The two most common signs of essential fatty acid deficiency are poor growth in fish and low feed efficiency.

quote: （1）饲料中适宜比例的LNA/LA (0.94) 可促进鳜鱼生长，提高其生长性能。
statement: 饲料中LNA/LA比例为0.94时可促进鳜鱼生长，提高生长性能。
text_zh: 饲料中LNA/LA比例为0.94时可促进鳜鱼生长，提高生长性能。
text_en: A dietary LNA/LA ratio of 0.94 can promote the growth of mandarin fish and improve growth performance.

quote: An increase in the essential fatty acids level of the diet, than the required level may lead to growth depression (Yu and Sinnhuber 1976; Takeuchi and Watanabe 1979).
statement: 膳食中必需脂肪酸水平超过所需水平可能导致生长抑制。
text_zh: 膳食中必需脂肪酸水平超过所需水平可能导致生长抑制。
text_en: Dietary levels of essential fatty acids exceeding the required level may lead to growth inhibition.

quote: Vitamins are organic compounds, obligatory in the fish feed for regular growth and health.
statement: 维生素是鱼类饲料中对正常生长和健康必不可少的有机化合物。
text_zh: 维生素是鱼类饲料中对正常生长和健康必不可少的有机化合物。
text_en: Vitamins are organic compounds essential for normal growth and health in fish feed.

quote: but their absence in the diets can make animal vulnerable to many diseases (NRC 1993; Lovell 1998).
statement: 饮食中缺乏维生素会使动物容易感染多种疾病。
text_zh: 饮食中缺乏维生素会使动物容易感染多种疾病。
text_en: A diet lacking in vitamins makes animals susceptible to various diseases.

quote: In the farming animals, several diseases were caused by the deficiency of vitamins in the diets, it is considered, that‘s animals may develop a disease, when they fed with vitamins deficit diet for a long time of period (Halver and Hardy 2002).
statement: 在养殖动物中，几种疾病是由饮食中维生素缺乏引起的，认为当动物长期喂食维生素缺乏的饮食时可能会患病。
text_zh: 在养殖动物中，几种疾病是由饮食中维生素缺乏引起的，认为当动物长期喂食维生素缺乏的饮食时可能会患病。
text_en: In farmed animals, several diseases are caused by dietary vitamin deficiencies; it is believed that animals may become ill when fed a vitamin-deficient diet for a long time.

quote: The inclusion of high level of dietary protein, not only cause an increase of feed cost, but also may affect protein efficiency of the culture species, and cause culture environment deterioration via excess ammonia excretion (Kim and Lee 2005).
statement: 饲料中高水平蛋白质的添加不仅会增加饲料成本，还可能影响养殖物种的蛋白质效率，并通过过量的氨排泄导致养殖环境恶化。
text_zh: 饲料中高水平蛋白质的添加不仅会增加饲料成本，还可能影响养殖物种的蛋白质效率，并通过过量的氨排泄导致养殖环境恶化。
text_en: The addition of high levels of protein in feed not only increases feed costs, but may also affect the protein efficiency of farmed species and deteriorate the farming environment through excessive ammonia excretion.

quote: The efficiency of dietary protein can be improved, with high energy diet, by partial replacement of protein with non-protein energy sources lipids/carbohydrates.
statement: 通过使用脂质或碳水化合物等非蛋白质能量源部分替代蛋白质，可以在高能日粮中提高膳食蛋白质的效率。
text_zh: 通过使用脂质或碳水化合物等非蛋白质能量源部分替代蛋白质，可以在高能日粮中提高膳食蛋白质的效率。
text_en: Partially replacing protein with non-protein energy sources such as lipids or carbohydrates can improve the efficiency of dietary protein in high-energy diets.
intervention: Fat replacing part of protein for energy
intervention_record: 以脂肪替代部分蛋白供能

quote: On the other hand, excess dietary energy may have some negative effect on growth, feed consumption and may lead to high lipids deposition in the body (Page and Andrews 1973; Prather and Lovell 1973; Shiau and Huang 1990).
statement: 另一方面，过量的膳食能量可能对生长和摄食产生负面影响，并可能导致体内脂质沉积过高。
text_zh: 另一方面，过量的膳食能量可能对生长和摄食产生负面影响，并可能导致体内脂质沉积过高。
text_en: On the other hand, excessive dietary energy may have negative effects on growth and feed intake, and may lead to excessive lipid deposition in the body.

quote: Feed in animal health plays an Important role, feeding animals with low nutrients, not only affect animal growth and feeding efficiency but also increase the risk of vulnerability to disease which may lead to structural deformative appearance or signs, and also cause alteration of behavior‘s and pathological changes.
statement: 低营养饲料不仅影响动物生长和摄食效率，还增加患病风险，可能导致结构畸形、行为改变和病理变化。
text_zh: 低营养饲料不仅影响动物生长和摄食效率，还增加患病风险，可能导致结构畸形、行为改变和病理变化。
text_en: Low-nutrient feed not only affects animal growth and feeding efficiency, but also increases the risk of disease, potentially leading to structural deformities, behavioral changes, and pathological changes.
outcome: 生长、摄食效率、疾病易感性、形态与行为

quote: Imbalance fish feed may also persuade negative interactions or antagonism among nutrients that aggravate symbols similar to deficit of nutrients.
statement: 不平衡的鱼饲料可能引起营养素之间的负面相互作用或拮抗，加剧类似营养缺乏的症状。
text_zh: 不平衡的鱼饲料可能引起营养素之间的负面相互作用或拮抗，加剧类似营养缺乏的症状。
text_en: Imbalanced fish feed may cause negative interactions or antagonism between nutrients, exacerbating symptoms similar to nutritional deficiencies.

quote: Any unusual and high amount of nutrients in the fish feed can cause toxicity.
statement: 鱼饲料中任何异常高含量的营养素都可能导致毒性。
text_zh: 鱼饲料中任何异常高含量的营养素都可能导致毒性。
text_en: Any abnormally high nutrient content in fish feed may cause toxicity.

quote: Therefore, it is crucial to take precaution before adding any nutrients supplementation for the sack of potential gain in the fish feed.
statement: 因此，为了潜在收益而在鱼饲料中添加任何营养补充剂之前采取预防措施至关重要。
text_zh: 因此，为了潜在收益而在鱼饲料中添加任何营养补充剂之前采取预防措施至关重要。
text_en: Therefore, it is crucial to take preventive measures before adding any nutritional supplements to fish feed for potential benefits.
intervention_record: 营养补充前的预防与稳定营养

quote: And furthermore, it is utmost important to ensure the fish feed with stable amount of required nutrients for the specific development and physiological need of the cultured fish species.
statement: 此外，确保养殖鱼类具有稳定数量的所需营养素以满足其特定发育和生理需求极为重要。
text_zh: 此外，确保养殖鱼类具有稳定数量的所需营养素以满足其特定发育和生理需求极为重要。
text_en: In addition, it is extremely important to ensure that farmed fish have a stable quantity of the required nutrients to meet their specific developmental and physiological needs.
intervention_record: 营养补充前的预防与稳定营养

quote: The results showed that P/E ratio diets significantly affected both fish performance.
statement: P/E-Ratio-Diäten beeinflussten die Leistung beider Fischarten signifikant.
text_en: P/E-Ratio-Diäten beeinflussten die Leistung beider Fischarten signifikant.

quote: Bait fish in group A showed significantly lower weight gain (WG), specific growth rate (SGR), and higher Viscerosomatic index (VSI) and Hepatosomatic index (HSI) compared to other groups.
statement: Köderfische der Gruppe A zeigten im Vergleich zu den anderen Gruppen eine signifikant geringere Gewichtszunahme, spezifische Wachstumsrate sowie höhere viszeralesomatische und hepatisosomatische Indizes.
text_en: Köderfische der Gruppe A zeigten im Vergleich zu den anderen Gruppen eine signifikant geringere Gewichtszunahme, spezifische Wachstumsrate sowie höhere viszeralesomatische und hepatisosomatische Indizes.

quote: Similarly, in Chinese perch, group A, showed significantly lower WG, SGR, protein efficiency ratio (PER) and higher feed intake (FI), feed conversion ratio (FCR), VSI, HSI, and Intraperitoneal fat (IPF), compare to other groups.
statement: Beim Chinesischen Barsch zeigte die Gruppe A im Vergleich zu den anderen Gruppen eine signifikant geringere Gewichtszunahme, spezifische Wachstumsrate und Proteineffizienz sowie eine höhere Futteraufnahme, Futterverwertungsrate, viszerale und hepatische Indizes sowie intraperitoneales Fett.
text_en: Beim Chinesischen Barsch zeigte die Gruppe A im Vergleich zu den anderen Gruppen eine signifikant geringere Gewichtszunahme, spezifische Wachstumsrate und Proteineffizienz sowie eine höhere Futteraufnahme, Futterverwertungsrate, viszerale und hepatische Indizes sowie intraperitoneales Fett.

quote: Bait fish in group A showed significantly lower whole-body crude protein and higher lipid contents compared to other groups.
statement: Köderfische der Gruppe A wiesen im Vergleich zu den anderen Gruppen einen signifikant niedrigeren Rohproteingehalt und einen höheren Lipidgehalt im ganzen Körper auf.
text_en: Köderfische der Gruppe A wiesen im Vergleich zu den anderen Gruppen einen signifikant niedrigeren Rohproteingehalt und einen höheren Lipidgehalt im ganzen Körper auf.

quote: The AMPK and mTOR pathway gene expression showed a low energy status and protein catabolism in group A of Chinese perch.
statement: Die Genexpression des AMPK- und mTOR-Signalwegs deutete bei der Gruppe A des Chinesischen Barschs auf einen niedrigen Energiestatus und Proteinabbau hin.
text_en: Die Genexpression des AMPK- und mTOR-Signalwegs deutete bei der Gruppe A des Chinesischen Barschs auf einen niedrigen Energiestatus und Proteinabbau hin.

quote:
Therefore, it is important to quantify the precise nutritional
requirement of culture fish, establishment of bioavailability of different feed ingredients,
theirs cost and availability, and the technology use in feed processing and culture.
statement: 量化养殖鱼类的精确营养需求、建立不同饲料原料的生物利用度、其成本和可用性，以及饲料加工和养殖中的技术应用非常重要。
text_zh: 量化养殖鱼类的精确营养需求、建立不同饲料原料的生物利用度、其成本和可用性，以及饲料加工和养殖中的技术应用非常重要。
text_en: It is important to quantify the precise nutritional requirements of farmed fish, establish the bioavailability, cost and availability of different feed ingredients, and apply technical methods in feed processing and aquaculture.

quote:
These
should be in order and ensure the use of nutritionally balanced, and cost-effective diets to
be formulated to maintain proper health of fish and also maximize culture production.
statement: 应确保使用营养均衡且具有成本效益的日粮配方，以维持鱼类的适当健康并最大化养殖产量。
text_zh: 应确保使用营养均衡且具有成本效益的日粮配方，以维持鱼类的适当健康并最大化养殖产量。
text_en: It should be ensured that nutritionally balanced and cost-effective diet formulations are used to maintain proper fish health and maximize aquaculture yield.

quote:
Fish need dietary energy sources and nutrients for maintenance of proper growth,
health and reproduction.
statement: 鱼类需要膳食能量来源和营养素来维持适当的生长、健康和繁殖。
text_zh: 鱼类需要膳食能量来源和营养素来维持适当的生长、健康和繁殖。
text_en: Fish require dietary energy sources and nutrients to maintain proper growth, health, and reproduction.

quote:
Therefore, to avoid such negative effect of the dietary energy, it is important to pay
attention to the whole dietary energy and the protein/energy in the diet of culture species.
statement: 为了避免膳食能量的负面效应，需要关注养殖物种日粮中的总能量和蛋白/能量比。
text_zh: 为了避免膳食能量的负面效应，需要关注养殖物种日粮中的总能量和蛋白/能量比。
text_en: To avoid the negative effects on dietary energy, attention should be paid to the total energy and protein/energy ratio in the diets of farmed species.
intervention: Adjusting total energy and P/E ratio
intervention_record: 调整总能量及蛋白能量比

quote: However, its impact to the all species are not the same, some species can utilize high lipids while others can‘t, but the major problem and concern about high lipids levels in the diet is the deposition of body fats and changes in the lipogenic enzymes activities (Dias 1999; Regost 2001).
statement: High lipid levels in the diet cause body fat deposition and changes in lipogenic enzyme activities, though utilization varies by species.
text_en: High lipid levels in the diet cause body fat deposition and changes in lipogenic enzyme activities, though utilization varies by species.

quote: the protein requirement of mrigal fry of different ages and different body weights is 30%- 40% between them can better and healthier growth.
statement: 不同年龄和体重的鲮鱼苗蛋白质需求在30%-40%之间时，生长更好、更健康。
text_zh: 不同年龄和体重的鲮鱼苗蛋白质需求在30%-40%之间时，生长更好、更健康。
text_en: Mud carp fry of different ages and weights grow better and are healthier when their protein requirement is between 30% and 40%.

quote: However, the feeding conditions, experimental design, environmental factors, fish size and dietary contents variation greatly affect the nutritional status of fish.
statement: 饲养条件、实验设计、环境因素、鱼体大小和日粮成分的变化极大地影响鱼类的营养状况。
text_zh: 饲养条件、实验设计、环境因素、鱼体大小和日粮成分的变化极大地影响鱼类的营养状况。
text_en: Variations in rearing conditions, experimental design, environmental factors, fish size and dietary composition greatly affect the nutritional status of fish.

quote: Probiotics, also known as beneficial bacteria widely used in aquaculture production.
statement: 益生菌被称为有益菌，广泛用于水产养殖生产。
text_zh: 益生菌被称为有益菌，广泛用于水产养殖生产。
text_en: Probiotics, known as beneficial bacteria, are widely used in aquaculture production.

quote: They are mainly used to improve water quality and cultured environment of the desired species.
statement: 它们主要用于改善目标物种的水质和养殖环境。
text_zh: 它们主要用于改善目标物种的水质和养殖环境。
text_en: They are mainly used to improve water quality and the farming environment for target species.

quote: Due to the complicated water environment and relative instability of the number of bacteria in aquatic animals, the current aquaculture probiotics research mainly focus on lactic acid bacteria, bacillus coli, yeast, photosynthetic bacteria, nitrobacteria and improve water quality bacteria (bacteria, denitrifying bacteria), etc., through the direct or indirect role in effectively improving healthy aquaculture production.
statement: 由于水环境的复杂性和水生动物体内细菌数量的相对不稳定性，当前的水产养殖益生菌研究主要集中在乳酸菌、大肠杆菌、酵母、光合细菌、硝化细菌和改善水质的细菌等，通过直接或间接作用有效改善健康的水产养殖生产。
text_zh: 由于水环境的复杂性和水生动物体内细菌数量的相对不稳定性，当前的水产养殖益生菌研究主要集中在乳酸菌、大肠杆菌、酵母、光合细菌、硝化细菌和改善水质的细菌等，通过直接或间接作用有效改善健康的水产养殖生产。
text_en: Due to the complexity of the aquatic environment and the relative instability of bacterial numbers within aquatic animals, current research on aquaculture probiotics mainly focuses on lactic acid bacteria, Escherichia coli, yeast, photosynthetic bacteria, nitrifying bacteria, and bacteria that improve water quality, effectively improving healthy aquaculture production through direct or indirect actions.
limitations: 水环境复杂且细菌数量不稳定

quote:
The high protein cost
makes it necessary to maximize the use of non-protein energy sources to lower the feed
cost without compromising on its health status.
statement: 为了在不损害健康状况的前提下降低饲料成本，有必要最大限度地利用非蛋白质能源。
text_zh: 为了在不损害健康状况的前提下降低饲料成本，有必要最大限度地利用非蛋白质能源。
text_en: To reduce feed costs without compromising health status, it is necessary to maximize the utilization of non-protein energy.
intervention_record: 最大化利用非蛋白能源

quote: After feeding, the cart transcription level was significantly improved and the food intake of goldfish was decreased (Volkoff and Peter 2000).
statement: 喂食后，cart转录水平显著提高，金鱼的摄食量减少。
text_zh: 喂食后，cart转录水平显著提高，金鱼的摄食量减少。
text_en: After feeding, cart transcription levels increased significantly, and the feed intake of goldfish decreased.

quote: Although dietary protein is significant for the growth and metabolism of carnivorous fish, excessive dietary protein can be metabolized as an energy source, resulting in increased feed cost and nitrogenous waste that potentially impairs fish growth and metabolism (Cho and Bureau 2001).
statement: Excessive dietary protein in carnivorous fish can be metabolized as an energy source, leading to increased feed costs and nitrogenous waste that may impair growth and metabolism.
text_en: Excessive dietary protein in carnivorous fish can be metabolized as an energy source, leading to increased feed costs and nitrogenous waste that may impair growth and metabolism.

quote: Moreover, supplementation of dietary minerals is very cheap, that‘s make it easy to avoids its deficiency problem in aquaculture forming (Hardy 2001).
statement: 膳食矿物质补充非常便宜，这使得在水产养殖中避免缺乏症变得容易。
text_zh: 膳食矿物质补充非常便宜，这使得在水产养殖中避免缺乏症变得容易。
text_en: Dietary mineral supplementation is very cheap, which makes it easy to avoid deficiencies in aquaculture.

quote: Therefore, it is necessary to strictly monitor these minerals addition in the fish diet and to avoid the accumulation in fish body and related health problem.
statement: 因此，有必要严格监测鱼饲料中这些矿物质的添加，以避免在鱼体内积累及相关健康问题。
text_zh: 因此，有必要严格监测鱼饲料中这些矿物质的添加，以避免在鱼体内积累及相关健康问题。
text_en: Therefore, it is necessary to strictly monitor the addition of these minerals in fish feed to avoid accumulation in fish and related health problems.

quote: 本研究旨在探究人工饲料中蛋白质与能量比对翘嘴鳜生长性能、摄食量、鱼体成分、饲料利用率、氮代谢酶活性和基因表达的影响。
statement: 研究旨在探究人工饲料中蛋白质与能量比（P/E）对翘嘴鳜多项生理指标的影响。
text_zh: 研究旨在探究人工饲料中蛋白质与能量比（P/E）对翘嘴鳜多项生理指标的影响。
text_en: The study aimed to investigate the effects of the protein-to-energy ratio (P/E) in artificial feed on multiple physiological indicators of the topmouth culter.
outcome: 生长性能、摄食量、鱼体成分、饲料利用率、氮代谢酶活性、基因表达

quote: 结果表明，不同P/E 饲料对翘嘴鳜的生长性能、摄食量、鱼体成分、饲料利用率、氮代谢酶和基因表达均有显着影响。
statement: 不同水平的饲料P/E比对翘嘴鳜的生长性能、摄食量、鱼体成分、饲料利用率、氮代谢酶和基因表达有显著影响。
text_zh: 不同水平的饲料P/E比对翘嘴鳜的生长性能、摄食量、鱼体成分、饲料利用率、氮代谢酶和基因表达有显著影响。
text_en: Different levels of dietary P/E ratio have significant effects on the growth performance, feed intake, body composition, feed utilization, nitrogen metabolic enzymes and gene expression of Chinese perch.
outcome: 生长性能、摄食量、鱼体成分、饲料利用率、氮代谢酶、基因表达

quote: 在食欲调节基因（NPY，AgRP，POMC 和CART）表达水平检测中发现，C 组的NPY 和AgRp 的基因表达明显高于其他组，但是，CART 和POMC 的基因表达不受饲料P/E 比的影响。
statement: 饲料P/E比影响了部分食欲调节基因（NPY, AgRP）的表达，但未影响另一些基因（CART, POMC）的表达。
text_zh: 饲料P/E比影响了部分食欲调节基因（NPY, AgRP）的表达，但未影响另一些基因（CART, POMC）的表达。
text_en: The dietary protein-to-energy ratio affected the expression of some appetite-regulating genes (NPY, AgRP), but did not affect the expression of other genes (CART, POMC).
counterevidence: CART 和POMC 的基因表达不受饲料P/E 比的影响

quote: 另外，A 组翘嘴鳜肝脏和肌肉中的氮代谢相关酶活性（丙氨酸转氨酶（ALT）、天冬氨酸转氨酶（AST）、谷氨酸脱氢酶（GDH）和腺苷酸脱氨酶（AMPD））以及GDH 和AMPD 基因表达均显着低于其他组。
statement: 低P/E比（A组）导致翘嘴鳜肝脏和肌肉中氮代谢相关酶活性及相关基因表达显著降低。
text_zh: 低P/E比（A组）导致翘嘴鳜肝脏和肌肉中氮代谢相关酶活性及相关基因表达显著降低。
text_en: Low P/E ratio (Group A) significantly reduced the activity of nitrogen metabolism-related enzymes and the expression of related genes in the liver and muscle of topmouth culter.
outcome: 氮代谢酶活性、基因表达

quote: 除此之外，实验还发现，与其他组相比，A 组翘嘴鳜肝脏中mTOR 通路中的mTOR，S6K 和4EBP1 的基因表达明显降低，而AMPK，LKB1 和eEF2 的基因表达明显升高。
statement: 低P/E比（A组）改变了翘嘴鳜肝脏中mTOR和AMPK信号通路相关基因的表达水平。
text_zh: 低P/E比（A组）改变了翘嘴鳜肝脏中mTOR和AMPK信号通路相关基因的表达水平。
text_en: The low P/E ratio (Group A) altered the expression levels of genes related to the mTOR and AMPK signaling pathways in the liver of Siniperca chuatsi.
outcome: 营养感应信号通路基因表达

quote: 此外，翘嘴鳜血液ALT，AST，总蛋白（TP），碱性磷酸酶（ALP），葡萄糖（GLU），血尿素氮（BUN）和甘油三酸酯（TG）的水平也受到饲料中不同P/E 比的影响。
statement: 饲料P/E比影响翘嘴鳜血液中多种生化指标的水平。
text_zh: 饲料P/E比影响翘嘴鳜血液中多种生化指标的水平。
text_en: The dietary protein-to-energy ratio affects the levels of multiple biochemical indicators in the blood of Siniperca chuatsi.

quote: 这些研究结果表明，饲料中P/E 比显著影响了翘嘴鳜的生长和代谢。
statement: 饲料P/E比显著影响翘嘴鳜的生长和代谢过程。
text_zh: 饲料P/E比显著影响翘嘴鳜的生长和代谢过程。
text_en: The dietary protein-to-energy ratio significantly affects the growth and metabolic processes of Siniperca chuatsi.

quote: 同时，基于对不同组别的翘嘴鳜增重进行二阶多项式回归分析发现，翘嘴鳜饲料中最适合的P/E 比为37.98 mg/kJ。
statement: 通过回归分析确定翘嘴鳜饲料的最适P/E比为37.98 mg/kJ。
text_zh: 通过回归分析确定翘嘴鳜饲料的最适P/E比为37.98 mg/kJ。
text_en: Regression analysis determined the optimal P/E ratio for feed of the topmouth culter to be 37.98 mg/kJ.

quote: 结果表明，不同P/E比例饲料显着影响麦鲮的生长性能、饲料利用率、体成分和氮代谢酶活性。
statement: 不同P/E比例的饲料显著影响麦鲮的生长性能、饲料利用率、体成分和氮代谢酶活性。
text_zh: 不同P/E比例的饲料显著影响麦鲮的生长性能、饲料利用率、体成分和氮代谢酶活性。
text_en: Diets with different protein-to-energy ratios significantly affected the growth performance, feed utilization, body composition, and nitrogen metabolic enzyme activity of Cirrhinus mrigala.
outcome: 生长性能、饲料利用率、体成分、氮代谢酶活性

quote: A 组和E 组麦鲮的脏体比指数高于其他组。其中A 组的肝体比指数最高。
statement: 极端P/E比（A组和E组）导致麦鲮脏体比指数升高，其中A组肝体比指数最高。
text_zh: 极端P/E比（A组和E组）导致麦鲮脏体比指数升高，其中A组肝体比指数最高。
text_en: Extreme P/E ratios (groups A and E) led to an increase in the viscera somatic index of Cirrhinus mrigala, with group A having the highest hepatosomatic index.
intervention: Specific dietary treatments (Groups A and E)
outcome: 脏体比指数、肝体比指数

quote: Feed intake considered a very important factor in fish farming. That‘s shows the fish health, feeding status and diet acceptability.
statement: 摄食量被认为是鱼类养殖中一个非常重要的因素，它反映了鱼的健康状况、摄食状态和饲料适口性。
text_zh: 摄食量被认为是鱼类养殖中一个非常重要的因素，它反映了鱼的健康状况、摄食状态和饲料适口性。
text_en: Feed intake is considered a very important factor in fish farming, as it reflects the health status, feeding condition, and palatability of the feed.

quote: Previous studies reported that there are many factors affecting fish feed intake, such as hormones (Leptin, insulin), environmental stress, nutrients etc.
statement: 先前的研究报道了影响鱼类摄食量的许多因素，如激素（瘦素、胰岛素）、环境压力、营养物质等。
text_zh: 先前的研究报道了影响鱼类摄食量的许多因素，如激素（瘦素、胰岛素）、环境压力、营养物质等。
text_en: Previous studies have reported many factors affecting fish feed intake, such as hormones (leptin, insulin), environmental stress, nutrients, etc.

quote: In most aquaculture fishes, it has been recognized efficient, that the DP/DE ratio of the diet has significantly improved protein utilization and also expressively lowered the nitrogen excretion to the culture system
statement: 在大多数养殖鱼类中，已认识到日粮的DP/DE比率能显著提高蛋白质利用率，并明显降低排入养殖系统的氮排泄量。
text_zh: 在大多数养殖鱼类中，已认识到日粮的DP/DE比率能显著提高蛋白质利用率，并明显降低排入养殖系统的氮排泄量。
text_en: In most farmed fish, it has been recognized that the dietary DP/DE ratio can significantly improve protein utilization and markedly reduce nitrogen excretion into the farming system.

quote: Chinese perch were starved for 1 day and euthanized with 75 mg/L tricaine methane-sulfonate (Argent Chemical Laboratories, Redmond, WA, USA).
statement: 实验结束时，鳜鱼被禁食一天，并使用75 mg/L的三卡甲烷磺酸进行安乐死。
text_zh: 实验结束时，鳜鱼被禁食一天，并使用75 mg/L的三卡甲烷磺酸进行安乐死。
text_en: At the end of the experiment, mandarin fish were fasted for one day and euthanized using 75 mg/L of tricaine methanesulfonate.

quote: Blood samples were taken from the caudal vein of the fish and stored at 4 °C overnight and then centrifuged at 2500× g for 20 min.
statement: 从鱼的尾静脉采集血液样本，并在4°C下过夜保存，随后在2500×g条件下离心20分钟。
text_zh: 从鱼的尾静脉采集血液样本，并在4°C下过夜保存，随后在2500×g条件下离心20分钟。
text_en: Blood samples were collected from the caudal vein of fish, stored overnight at 4°C, and then centrifuged at 2500×g for 20 minutes.

quote: Artificial feed of Chinese perch (Liang et al 2002) has also been preliminarily studied.
statement: 鳜鱼的人工饲料研究已初步开展。
text_zh: 鳜鱼的人工饲料研究已初步开展。
text_en: Research on artificial feed for mandarin fish has been preliminarily carried out.

quote: Some studies have been conducted on the artificial dietary protein requirement (Liang et al 2002; Wang et al 2005), Similarly, the live and artificial diet effect on hybrid Chinese perch (Li et al 2017), comparative effect of live feed, frozen feed and artificial diets (Li et al 2015c), formulated and minced fish co-diet effect (Li et al 2018b), the apparent digestibility of different feed ingredients (Mo et al 2019) and artificial diet lipids metabolism in Chinese perch have been envaulted (Wang et al 2018).
statement: 已有研究涉及鳜鱼的人工饲料蛋白质需求、活饵与人工饲料对杂交鳜的影响、不同饲料类型的比较效应、配合饲料与碎鱼共饲效应、不同饲料原料的表观消化率以及人工饲料脂质代谢。
text_zh: 已有研究涉及鳜鱼的人工饲料蛋白质需求、活饵与人工饲料对杂交鳜的影响、不同饲料类型的比较效应、配合饲料与碎鱼共饲效应、不同饲料原料的表观消化率以及人工饲料脂质代谢。
text_en: Existing studies have addressed the dietary protein requirements of mandarin fish for artificial feed, the effects of live bait versus artificial feed on hybrid mandarin fish, comparative effects of different feed types, co-feeding effects of formulated feed and chopped fish, apparent digestibility of different feed ingredients, and lipid metabolism in artificial feed.

quote: However, there is still a lack of studies on the nutrition of the feed of the mandarin fish, and currently this is an emerging research area for artificial diet optimization of Chinese.
statement: 然而，关于鳜鱼饲料营养的研究仍然缺乏，目前这是中国鳜鱼人工饲料优化的一个新兴研究领域。
text_zh: 然而，关于鳜鱼饲料营养的研究仍然缺乏，目前这是中国鳜鱼人工饲料优化的一个新兴研究领域。
text_en: However, research on the nutritional aspects of mandarin fish feed is still lacking; currently, this is an emerging area of study for optimizing artificial feeds for mandarin fish in China.

quote: During the process of domestication and optimization of feed formula, we found that Chinese perch is very sensitive to dietary protein ratio, which is an ideal interest for exploring the regulation of dietary protein imbalance on protein synthesis and energy homeostasis.
statement: 在驯化和饲料配方优化过程中，我们发现鳜鱼对日粮蛋白比例非常敏感，这为探索日粮蛋白失衡对蛋白质合成和能量稳态的调节提供了理想切入点。
text_zh: 在驯化和饲料配方优化过程中，我们发现鳜鱼对日粮蛋白比例非常敏感，这为探索日粮蛋白失衡对蛋白质合成和能量稳态的调节提供了理想切入点。
text_en: During the domestication and feed formulation optimization process, we found that mandarin fish are very sensitive to dietary protein ratio, which provides an ideal entry point for exploring the regulation of protein synthesis and energy homeostasis by dietary protein imbalance.
outcome: 蛋白质合成与能量稳态

quote: However, the HSI in Groups A and E was significantly higher than that in other groups.
statement: A组和E组的肝体指数显著高于其他组。
text_zh: A组和E组的肝体指数显著高于其他组。
text_en: The hepatosomatic index of groups A and E was significantly higher than that of the other groups.

quote: The influence of photosynthetic bacteria on water body and soil yield by mixing in sediment and adding photosynthetic bacteria could reduce the ammonia nitrogen content in water body on average and increase the dissolved oxygen content in pond water on average and increase the soil yield per mu on average.
statement: 通过混合沉积物并添加光合细菌，可降低水体平均氨氮含量，增加池塘水平均溶解氧含量，并增加平均亩产土壤产量。
text_zh: 通过混合沉积物并添加光合细菌，可降低水体平均氨氮含量，增加池塘水平均溶解氧含量，并增加平均亩产土壤产量。
text_en: By mixing the sediment and adding photosynthetic bacteria, the average ammonia nitrogen content in the water body can be reduced, the average dissolved oxygen content at the pond level can be increased, and the average soil yield per mu can be increased.

quote: Similarly, the photosynthetic bacteria addition improved fish larvae survival rate and enhanced scallop seed production (Huang et al 1990).
statement: 同样，添加光合细菌提高了鱼苗存活率并增强了扇贝育苗生产(Huang等人1990)。
text_zh: 同样，添加光合细菌提高了鱼苗存活率并增强了扇贝育苗生产(Huang等人1990)。
text_en: Similarly, the addition of photosynthetic bacteria improved fry survival rate and enhanced scallop seedling production (Huang et al. 1990).

quote:
, and bighead carps, are optimal for Chinese perch as a live feed (Li et al.
2014b; Yao and Liang 2015).
statement: 鳙鱼等作为鳜鱼的活饵是最佳的。
text_zh: 鳙鱼等作为鳜鱼的活饵是最佳的。
text_en: Silver carp and others are the best live bait for mandarin fish.

quote:
Therefore, it is important and should be
pay attention to the palatable live feed fish for Chinese perch culture in ponds, because
the size of live feed fish may affect on the growth of Chinese perch.
statement: 池塘养殖中应注意适口活饵的大小，因为活饵大小可能影响鳜鱼生长。
text_zh: 池塘养殖中应注意适口活饵的大小，因为活饵大小可能影响鳜鱼生长。
text_en: In pond culture, attention should be paid to the size of palatable live bait, as the size of live bait may affect the growth of mandarin fish.

quote:
Currently in
general, the feed conversion ratio in the pond culture is 4-5. And the live feed fish will
need about four times higher space as of the Chinese perch culture ponds.
statement: 目前池塘养殖的饲料系数一般为4-5，且活饵鱼需要比鳜鱼养殖池多四倍的空间。
text_zh: 目前池塘养殖的饲料系数一般为4-5，且活饵鱼需要比鳜鱼养殖池多四倍的空间。
text_en: Currently, the feed conversion ratio for pond farming is generally 4-5, and live bait fish require four times more space than mandarin fish farming ponds.
counterevidence: 活饵养殖占用大量空间和资源

quote:
however after designing a successful
training protocol by (Liang et al 2002) it becomes possible to feed artificial diet to
Chinese perch,
statement: 通过设计成功的驯化方案后，可以喂食人工配合饲料给鳜鱼。
text_zh: 通过设计成功的驯化方案后，可以喂食人工配合饲料给鳜鱼。
text_en: After designing a successful acclimation scheme, mandarin fish can be fed artificial formulated feed.

quote: The nitrogen metabolism enzyme activities of ALT, AST, and GDH in the liver and AMPD in muscle tissue are shown in Figure 2.2a–d. These enzymes were significantly affected by the P/E ratios in the experimental diets.
statement: 实验日粮中的蛋白/能量比（P/E）显著影响了肝脏中ALT、AST和GDH以及肌肉中AMPD的氮代谢酶活性。
text_zh: 实验日粮中的蛋白/能量比（P/E）显著影响了肝脏中ALT、AST和GDH以及肌肉中AMPD的氮代谢酶活性。
text_en: The protein/energy ratio (P/E) in the experimental diets significantly affected the activity of nitrogen metabolism enzymes ALT, AST, and GDH in the liver and AMPD in the muscle.

quote:
Serum biochemical parameters were significantly affected by the experimental diets
(Table 2.6).
statement: 实验日粮显著影响了血清生化参数。
text_zh: 实验日粮显著影响了血清生化参数。
text_en: The experimental diets significantly affected serum biochemical parameters.

quote: ALT and AST were significantly higher in Groups A and E compared with those in the other groups; however, the ALP level showed no difference between any of the groups.
statement: A组和E组的谷丙转氨酶(ALT)和谷草转氨酶(AST)显著高于其他组；然而，各组间的碱性磷酸酶(ALP)水平无差异。
text_zh: A组和E组的谷丙转氨酶(ALT)和谷草转氨酶(AST)显著高于其他组；然而，各组间的碱性磷酸酶(ALP)水平无差异。
text_en: ALT and AST levels in groups A and E were significantly higher than those in other groups; however, there was no significant difference in ALP levels among the groups.

quote: Prior to the experiment, all fish were acclimatized to the experimental conditions and weaned onto the artificial diets for 4 weeks (Liang et al 2001).
statement: 实验前，所有鱼在实验条件下进行了为期4周的驯化并适应人工饲料。
text_zh: 实验前，所有鱼在实验条件下进行了为期4周的驯化并适应人工饲料。
text_en: Before the experiment, all fish underwent a 4-week acclimation under experimental conditions and adapted to artificial feed.

quote: After acclimatization, a total of 225 fish were randomly selected and distributed into 5 groups of 15 tanks (350 L). Each group was assigned to triplicate tanks, and each tank was stocked with 15 fish (fish weight: 64.89 ± 0.28 g) fed with the respective P/E ratio diets.
statement: 驯化后，将225条鱼随机分配到5组共15个水箱中，每箱放养15条鱼，喂食不同蛋白能量比的饲料。
text_zh: 驯化后，将225条鱼随机分配到5组共15个水箱中，每箱放养15条鱼，喂食不同蛋白能量比的饲料。
text_en: After acclimation, 225 fish were randomly assigned to 5 groups in a total of 15 tanks, with 15 fish stocked per tank, and fed diets with different protein-to-energy ratios.

quote: During the culture period, fish were fed twice a day at 08:00 and 17:00 at 4% of fish wet body weight.
statement: 养殖期间，每天08:00和17:00两次投喂，投喂量为鱼体湿重的4%。
text_zh: 养殖期间，每天08:00和17:00两次投喂，投喂量为鱼体湿重的4%。
text_en: During the farming period, feeding was carried out twice daily at 08:00 and 17:00, with a feed amount of 4% of the fish's wet body weight.

quote: Throughout the culture period, the filtered water flow rate was 3 L min−1, the photoperiod was 12/12 h (light/dark), the pH value was around 7.81 ± 0.21, the ammonia content was approximately 0.18 ± 0.04 mg/L, the dissolved oxygen (DO) was about 7 mg/L, and the water temperature was around 24 ± 2 ° C.
statement: 整个养殖期间，过滤水流速为3升/分钟，光周期为12小时光照/12小时黑暗，pH值约为7.81±0.21，氨氮含量约为0.18±0.04毫克/升，溶解氧约为7毫克/升，水温约为24±2°C。
text_zh: 整个养殖期间，过滤水流速为3升/分钟，光周期为12小时光照/12小时黑暗，pH值约为7.81±0.21，氨氮含量约为0.18±0.04毫克/升，溶解氧约为7毫克/升，水温约为24±2°C。
text_en: Throughout the entire rearing period, the filtered water flow rate was 3 L/min, the photoperiod was 12 hours light/12 hours dark, pH was about 7.81±0.21, ammonia nitrogen content was about 0.18±0.04 mg/L, dissolved oxygen was about 7 mg/L, and water temperature was about 24±2°C.

quote: The expression of the NPY and AgRp genes was significantly affected by the P/E ratio of the experimental diets.
statement: 实验日粮的蛋白/能量比显著影响了NPY和AgRp基因的表达。
text_zh: 实验日粮的蛋白/能量比显著影响了NPY和AgRp基因的表达。
text_en: The protein/energy ratio of the experimental diets significantly affected the expression of NPY and AgRp genes.

quote: Compared with the expression levels in the other groups, the expression of both genes was significantly higher in Group C and significantly lower in Group A.
statement: 与其他组相比，C组中这两个基因的表达显著较高，而A组中显著较低。
text_zh: 与其他组相比，C组中这两个基因的表达显著较高，而A组中显著较低。
text_en: Compared with the other groups, the expression of these two genes was significantly higher in group C and significantly lower in group A.

quote: The feed conversion ratio (FCR) was significantly lower in Group C compared with the other groups, while feed intake (FI) in Groups C and B was significantly lower compared with that of the other groups.
statement: C组的饲料转化率显著低于其他各组，而C组和B组的采食量显著低于其他各组。
text_zh: C组的饲料转化率显著低于其他各组，而C组和B组的采食量显著低于其他各组。
text_en: The feed conversion ratio of group C was significantly lower than that of all other groups, while the feed intake of groups C and B was significantly lower than that of all other groups.

quote: Chines perch eat solely on live fish and shrimp thought the life stages.
statement: 鳜鱼在整个生命阶段仅以活鱼和虾为食。
text_zh: 鳜鱼在整个生命阶段仅以活鱼和虾为食。
text_en: Mandarin fish feed exclusively on live fish and shrimp throughout their entire life stage.

quote: Correspondingly, fish in Group E (high P/E ratio) had lower weight gain compared with Group C, which illustrates the catabolism of excess protein to metabolize excessive amino acids (Jauncey 1982; Martinez‐Palacios et al 1996).
statement: 高P/E比组（E组）的鱼体重增加低于C组，这说明了过量蛋白质的分解代谢以处理过量的氨基酸。
text_zh: 高P/E比组（E组）的鱼体重增加低于C组，这说明了过量蛋白质的分解代谢以处理过量的氨基酸。
text_en: Fish in the high P/E ratio group (Group E) had lower body weight gain than those in Group C, indicating that excess protein was catabolized to handle excess amino acids.

quote: This may result in further energy costs through deamination and amino acid excretion (Yang et al 2003; Guo et al 2012).
statement: 这可能通过脱氨基作用和氨基酸排泄导致进一步的能量成本。
text_zh: 这可能通过脱氨基作用和氨基酸排泄导致进一步的能量成本。
text_en: This may lead to further energy costs through deamination and amino acid excretion.

quote: In the present study, the highest VSI, HSI, and IPF ratio were found in Groups A and E.
statement: 在本研究中，A组和E组的VSI、HSI和IPF比率最高。
text_zh: 在本研究中，A组和E组的VSI、HSI和IPF比率最高。
text_en: In this study, groups A and E had the highest VSI, HSI, and IPF ratios.
intervention: Specific dietary treatments (Groups A and E)

quote: When the fish were fed with low P/E ratios diet, the expression of genes in the mTOR pathway was lower, and the expression of genes in the AMPK pathway was higher, indicating that low protein synthesis resulted in low growth performance and poor metabolism
statement: 饲喂低蛋白能量比日粮时，mTOR通路基因表达降低而AMPK通路基因表达升高，表明低蛋白质合成导致生长性能低下和代谢不良。
text_zh: 饲喂低蛋白能量比日粮时，mTOR通路基因表达降低而AMPK通路基因表达升高，表明低蛋白质合成导致生长性能低下和代谢不良。
text_en: When fed a low protein-to-energy ratio diet, mTOR pathway gene expression decreased while AMPK pathway gene expression increased, indicating that low protein synthesis leads to poor growth performance and metabolic dysfunction.

quote: the opposite trend was observed when fish were fed with high P/E ratio diets.
statement: 当鱼被饲喂高蛋白能量比日粮时，观察到相反的趋势（即生长性能和代谢状况改善）。
text_zh: 当鱼被饲喂高蛋白能量比日粮时，观察到相反的趋势（即生长性能和代谢状况改善）。
text_en: When fish were fed a high protein-to-energy ratio diet, the opposite trend was observed (i.e., improved growth performance and metabolic status).

quote: Blood ALT and AST were significantly higher in Groups A and E compared with those in the three other groups. This may be an indication of liver injuries or dysfunction since blood AST and ALT levels reflect these conditions (Mourente et al 2005).
statement: A组和E组的血液ALT和AST水平显著高于其他三组，这可能指示肝脏损伤或功能障碍。
text_zh: A组和E组的血液ALT和AST水平显著高于其他三组，这可能指示肝脏损伤或功能障碍。
text_en: The blood ALT and AST levels in Groups A and E were significantly higher than those in the other three groups, which may indicate liver damage or dysfunction.
intervention: Specific dietary treatments (Groups A and E)

quote: blood BUN levels were positively increased with an increased dietary P/E ratio in the experimental diets.
statement: 实验日粮中蛋白能量比的增加导致血液尿素氮（BUN）水平正向升高。
text_zh: 实验日粮中蛋白能量比的增加导致血液尿素氮（BUN）水平正向升高。
text_en: An increase in the protein-to-energy ratio in the experimental diet led to a positive increase in blood urea nitrogen (BUN) levels.

quote: A balanced ratio of dietary protein to non-protein energy can spare dietary protein from energy metabolism and improve protein utilization and fish growth (Schulz et al 2008; Li et al 2013b).
statement: A balanced ratio of dietary protein to non-protein energy spares protein from energy metabolism and improves protein utilization and fish growth.
text_en: A balanced ratio of dietary protein to non-protein energy spares protein from energy metabolism and improves protein utilization and fish growth.

quote: However, an optimal balance between dietary protein and energy components is essential since the surplus or absence of non-protein energy results in the lower utilization of dietary protein and energy, potentially reducing fish growth (Lupatsch et al 1998; Ali and Jauncey 2005; Okorie et al 2007).
statement: Surplus or absence of non-protein energy leads to lower utilization of dietary protein and energy, which can reduce fish growth.
text_en: Surplus or absence of non-protein energy leads to lower utilization of dietary protein and energy, which can reduce fish growth.
intervention: Excess or deficiency of non-protein energy
intervention_record: 非蛋白能量过剩或缺乏

quote: A balanced dietary P/E ratio is necessary for the regulation of food intake and metabolism of nutrients, including carbohydrates and lipids (Zhao et al 2010).
statement: A balanced dietary protein-to-energy ratio is necessary for regulating food intake and nutrient metabolism.
text_en: A balanced dietary protein-to-energy ratio is necessary for regulating food intake and nutrient metabolism.

quote: High feed intake improves fish growth and directly correlates with increased oxidative metabolism and protein synthesis as a result of surplus amino acids (Houlihan et al 1993).
statement: High feed intake improves fish growth and correlates with increased oxidative metabolism and protein synthesis due to surplus amino acids.
text_en: High feed intake improves fish growth and correlates with increased oxidative metabolism and protein synthesis due to surplus amino acids.

quote: During trial period, the temperature ranged from 22.5 to 30 °C and pH of water were 7.7~7.82 ± 0.25. The dissolved oxygen (DO) and ammonia content was ~7 and 0.11 ± 0.03 mg/L, respectively.
statement: 试验期间水温范围为22.5至30°C，pH值为7.7~7.82 ± 0.25，溶解氧约为7 mg/L，氨氮含量为0.11 ± 0.03 mg/L。
text_zh: 试验期间水温范围为22.5至30°C，pH值为7.7~7.82 ± 0.25，溶解氧约为7 mg/L，氨氮含量为0.11 ± 0.03 mg/L。
text_en: During the trial period, water temperature ranged from 22.5 to 30°C, pH was 7.7~7.82 ± 0.25, dissolved oxygen was about 7 mg/L, and ammonia nitrogen content was 0.11 ± 0.03 mg/L.
outcome: 水质参数（温度、pH、溶解氧、氨氮）

quote: Fish were randomly selected and sedated with MS-222 (tricaine methane-sulfonate), 75 mg/L (Liu et al 2012a).
statement: 鱼被随机选择并使用75 mg/L的MS-222（间氨基苯甲酸甲酯磺酸盐）进行镇静处理。
text_zh: 鱼被随机选择并使用75 mg/L的MS-222（间氨基苯甲酸甲酯磺酸盐）进行镇静处理。
text_en: Fish were randomly selected and sedated using 75 mg/L of MS-222 (tricaine methanesulfonate).
outcome: 采样过程中的动物福利（镇静以减少应激）

quote: Fish food should be balanced in terms of proteins, carbohydrates, lipids, and other nutrients in order to sustain their stable growth (Rueda-López et al 2011).
statement: 鱼类饲料应在蛋白质、碳水化合物、脂质和其他营养素方面保持平衡，以维持其稳定生长。
text_zh: 鱼类饲料应在蛋白质、碳水化合物、脂质和其他营养素方面保持平衡，以维持其稳定生长。
text_en: Fish feed should be balanced in terms of protein, carbohydrates, lipids and other nutrients to maintain stable growth.

quote: In this study, the growth performance and metabolism of Chinese perch were significantly affected by the dietary P/E ratio of the experimental diets.
statement: 本研究中，鳜鱼（Chinese perch）的生长性能和代谢受到实验日粮中蛋白/能量比（P/E ratio）的显著影响。
text_zh: 本研究中，鳜鱼（Chinese perch）的生长性能和代谢受到实验日粮中蛋白/能量比（P/E ratio）的显著影响。
text_en: In this study, the growth performance and metabolism of Chinese perch were significantly affected by the protein/energy ratio (P/E ratio) in the experimental diets.

quote: The WG and SGR of the Chinese perch showed an increasing trend as the dietary P/E ratio increased to 35.90; after that, a slightly decreasing trend was observed as the dietary P/E ratio further increased.
statement: 随着日粮蛋白/能量比增加至35.90，鳜鱼的增重率（WG）和特定生长率（SGR）呈上升趋势；此后，随着该比值进一步增加，呈现轻微下降趋势。
text_zh: 随着日粮蛋白/能量比增加至35.90，鳜鱼的增重率（WG）和特定生长率（SGR）呈上升趋势；此后，随着该比值进一步增加，呈现轻微下降趋势。
text_en: As the dietary protein/energy ratio increased to 35.90, the weight gain (WG) and specific growth rate (SGR) of mandarin fish showed an upward trend; thereafter, as this ratio further increased, they showed a slight downward trend.
counterevidence: 超过最佳比值后生长性能下降

quote: Generally, fish growth improves as the dietary protein increases to an optimal level, but dietary protein in excess of this level may have negative effects on fish growth and metabolism (Arshad Hossain et al 2010).
statement: 通常，随着膳食蛋白质增加到最佳水平，鱼类生长改善，但过量的膳食蛋白质可能对鱼类生长和代谢产生负面影响。
text_zh: 通常，随着膳食蛋白质增加到最佳水平，鱼类生长改善，但过量的膳食蛋白质可能对鱼类生长和代谢产生负面影响。
text_en: Generally, fish growth improves as dietary protein increases to the optimal level, but excessive dietary protein may have negative effects on fish growth and metabolism.
counterevidence: 过量蛋白质有负面影响

quote: Accordingly, in the present study, the best growth performance and feed utilization were observed in Group C compared with those in the other groups.
statement: 因此，在本研究中，与其他组相比，C组观察到最佳的生长性能和饲料利用率。
text_zh: 因此，在本研究中，与其他组相比，C组观察到最佳的生长性能和饲料利用率。
text_en: Therefore, in this study, Group C showed the best growth performance and feed utilization compared to other groups.

quote: A balance protein level in fish feed is a requisite for the optimal growth and the prevention of excessive protein utilization as an energy substrate (Cui et al 2017).
statement: 鱼类饲料中平衡的蛋白质水平是最佳生长和防止过量蛋白质作为能量底物被利用的必要条件。
text_zh: 鱼类饲料中平衡的蛋白质水平是最佳生长和防止过量蛋白质作为能量底物被利用的必要条件。
text_en: A balanced protein level in fish feed is a necessary condition for optimal growth and preventing excess protein from being used as an energy substrate.

quote: The inclusion of suitable dietary carbohydrate in fish feed has shown a significant decrease in ammonia excretion, improved fish growth and protein deposition in many fish species (Wang et al 2005c).
statement: 在鱼饲料中添加合适的膳食碳水化合物已被证明能显著减少氨排泄，改善多种鱼类的生长和蛋白质沉积。
text_zh: 在鱼饲料中添加合适的膳食碳水化合物已被证明能显著减少氨排泄，改善多种鱼类的生长和蛋白质沉积。
text_en: Adding appropriate dietary carbohydrates to fish feed has been proven to significantly reduce ammonia excretion and improve growth and protein deposition in various fish species.
outcome: 水质（氨排泄）与生长性能

quote: Generally, the dietary P/E ratio of formulating feed affects the protein utilization.
statement: 通常，配制饲料中的膳食蛋白/能量比影响蛋白质利用率。
text_zh: 通常，配制饲料中的膳食蛋白/能量比影响蛋白质利用率。
text_en: Usually, the dietary protein/energy ratio in formulated feed affects protein utilization.

quote: The unbalanced P/E ratios will increase the protein catabolism instead of the non-protein substrate catabolism (Kim et al 2005; Mohseni et al 2013b).
statement: 不平衡的蛋白/能量比会增加蛋白质分解代谢而非非蛋白质底物分解代谢。
text_zh: 不平衡的蛋白/能量比会增加蛋白质分解代谢而非非蛋白质底物分解代谢。
text_en: An imbalanced protein/energy ratio increases protein catabolism rather than non-protein substrate catabolism.
intervention_record: 非最优蛋白能量比日粮

quote: Furthermore, Lee et al. (2003) (Lee et al 2003) and Schulz et al. (2007) (Schulz et al 2007) found no significant body protein changes with dietary protein-level fluctuations.
statement: Lee et al. (2003) and Schulz et al. (2007) found no significant changes in body protein despite fluctuations in dietary protein levels.
text_en: Lee et al. (2003) and Schulz et al. (2007) found no significant changes in body protein despite fluctuations in dietary protein levels.

quote: After that level, increasing the dietary protein affects body protein deposition, growth performance, and metabolism, as observed in the fish that were fed a high P/E ratio diet (Group E).
statement: Increasing dietary protein beyond the optimal level affects body protein deposition, growth performance, and metabolism, as seen in fish fed a high P/E ratio diet.
text_en: Increasing dietary protein beyond the optimal level affects body protein deposition, growth performance, and metabolism, as seen in fish fed a high P/E ratio diet.

quote: This indicates that, at a low P/E ratio diet, the protein was below the optimal level and mostly used for body protein requirements, and dietary lipids and carbohydrates were not efficiently used for energy purposes.
statement: At a low P/E ratio diet, protein is below optimal levels and primarily used for body protein needs, while dietary lipids and carbohydrates are not efficiently used for energy.
text_en: At a low P/E ratio diet, protein is below optimal levels and primarily used for body protein needs, while dietary lipids and carbohydrates are not efficiently used for energy.

quote: The increase in hepatic activity of protein-metabolizing enzymes associated with high P/E ratio diets may indicate the use of excess protein as an energetic compound.
statement: 高蛋白能比（P/E）日粮导致的肝脏蛋白代谢酶活性增加，可能表明过量蛋白质被用作能量化合物。
text_zh: 高蛋白能比（P/E）日粮导致的肝脏蛋白代谢酶活性增加，可能表明过量蛋白质被用作能量化合物。
text_en: The increase in liver protein metabolic enzyme activity caused by high protein-to-energy ratio (P/E) diets may indicate that excess protein is being used as an energy compound.
outcome: 蛋白质代谢与能量利用

quote: Therefore, when dietary P/E ratios were higher than optimal, ammonia production and muscle quality were affected.
statement: 因此，当日粮P/E比高于最佳值时，氨的产生和肌肉品质受到影响。
text_zh: 因此，当日粮P/E比高于最佳值时，氨的产生和肌肉品质受到影响。
text_en: Therefore, when the dietary P/E ratio is higher than the optimal value, ammonia production and muscle quality are affected.

quote: Transaminase and deaminase enzyme activities have been useful for evaluating the feeding status of fish (Alexis and Papaparaskeva-Papoutsoglou 1986; Moyano et al 1991b; Melo et al 2006a).
statement: 转氨酶和脱氨酶的活性已被证明可用于评估鱼类的摄食状态。
text_zh: 转氨酶和脱氨酶的活性已被证明可用于评估鱼类的摄食状态。
text_en: The activity of transaminases and deaminases has been shown to be useful for assessing the feeding status of fish.
intervention_record: 转氨酶脱氨酶活性测定

quote: Amino acid-metabolizing enzyme levels and nitrogen excretion are reliable indicators of dietary protein utilization, and amino acid metabolism is involved in deamination and transamination reactions.
statement: 氨基酸代谢酶水平和氮排泄是日粮蛋白质利用率的可靠指标，且氨基酸代谢参与脱氨基和转氨基反应。
text_zh: 氨基酸代谢酶水平和氮排泄是日粮蛋白质利用率的可靠指标，且氨基酸代谢参与脱氨基和转氨基反应。
text_en: Amino acid metabolic enzyme levels and nitrogen excretion are reliable indicators of dietary protein utilization, and amino acid metabolism participates in deamination and transamination reactions.
intervention: Amino acid metabolic enzyme and nitrogen excretion monitoring
intervention_record: 氨基酸代谢酶及氮排泄监测

quote: In the present study, the P/E ratio in the experimental diets significantly affected ALT, AST, and GDH in the liver and AMPD in the muscle.
statement: 在本研究中，实验日粮中的蛋白/能量比（P/E ratio）显著影响了肝脏中的ALT、AST和GDH以及肌肉中的AMPD。
text_zh: 在本研究中，实验日粮中的蛋白/能量比（P/E ratio）显著影响了肝脏中的ALT、AST和GDH以及肌肉中的AMPD。
text_en: In this study, the protein/energy ratio (P/E ratio) in the experimental diet significantly affected ALT, AST and GDH in the liver and AMPD in the muscle.

quote: These enzymes (ALT, AST, GDH, and AMPD) and the mRNA expression of GDH and AMPD showed a significant increasing trend with the increasing dietary P/E ratio.
statement: 这些酶（ALT、AST、GDH和AMPD）以及GDH和AMPD的mRNA表达量随着日粮P/E比的增加呈显著上升趋势。
text_zh: 这些酶（ALT、AST、GDH和AMPD）以及GDH和AMPD的mRNA表达量随着日粮P/E比的增加呈显著上升趋势。
text_en: The levels of these enzymes (ALT, AST, GDH and AMPD) and the mRNA expression of GDH and AMPD showed a significant increasing trend with the increase in dietary P/E ratio.

quote: Similar results have been reported when dietary protein/carbohydrate ratios were increased. ALT and AST activities were increased in the liver of Sparus aurata (Metón et al 1999a), and similar results were observed for ALT in O. mykiss (Moyano et al 1991b), in AST and ALT in R. quelen (Melo et al 2006a), and in the GDH activity of the European eel (Anguilla Anguilla) (Suárez et al 1995).
statement: 当增加日粮蛋白/碳水化合物比例时，已报道了类似结果：金头鲷（Sparus aurata）肝脏中ALT和AST活性增加；虹鳟（O. mykiss）中观察到类似的ALT变化；条纹鲶（R. quelen）中AST和ALT变化相似；欧洲鳗鲡（Anguilla Anguilla）中GDH活性也呈现类似趋势。
text_zh: 当增加日粮蛋白/碳水化合物比例时，已报道了类似结果：金头鲷（Sparus aurata）肝脏中ALT和AST活性增加；虹鳟（O. mykiss）中观察到类似的ALT变化；条纹鲶（R. quelen）中AST和ALT变化相似；欧洲鳗鲡（Anguilla Anguilla）中GDH活性也呈现类似趋势。
text_en: Similar results have been reported when increasing the dietary protein/carbohydrate ratio: increased ALT and AST activities in the liver of gilthead seabream (Sparus aurata); similar ALT changes were observed in rainbow trout (O. mykiss); similar AST and ALT changes in striped catfish (R. quelen); and a similar trend in GDH activity in European eel (Anguilla Anguilla).

population.species: 金头鲷, 虹鳟, 条纹鲶, 欧洲鳗鲡

quote: Some earlier studies carried out on C. mrigala nutrition (feeding frequency, lipid, protein, feed acceptability, essential amino acids) including protein-to-energy ratio (Zehra and Khan 2017).
statement: 早期研究涉及mrigala的营养，包括投喂频率、脂质、蛋白质、饲料适口性、必需氨基酸以及蛋白能比。
text_zh: 早期研究涉及mrigala的营养，包括投喂频率、脂质、蛋白质、饲料适口性、必需氨基酸以及蛋白能比。
text_en: Early studies involved the nutrition of mrigala, including feeding frequency, lipids, proteins, feed palatability, essential amino acids, and protein-to-energy ratio.

quote: Moreover, mrigal diets traditionally contain various protein sources with the combination of other feed ingredients. This increased feed cost, imbalanced nitrogen utilization and increased nitrogen excretion to the aquaculture system.
statement: 传统的mrigala日粮含有多种蛋白质来源和其他饲料成分的组合，这增加了饲料成本，导致氮利用不平衡并增加了向养殖系统的氮排泄。
text_zh: 传统的mrigala日粮含有多种蛋白质来源和其他饲料成分的组合，这增加了饲料成本，导致氮利用不平衡并增加了向养殖系统的氮排泄。
text_en: Traditional mrigala diets contain a combination of multiple protein sources and other feed ingredients, which increases feed costs, leads to unbalanced nitrogen utilization, and increases nitrogen excretion into the farming system.
outcome: 水质（氮排泄）与经济效益
counterevidence: 增加饲料成本、氮利用不平衡、氮排泄增加

quote: As the dietary requirements varies with various developmental stages, therefore this study was aimed to determine the effect of dietary protein to energy ratios on growth performance, body composition, feed utilization and nitrogen metabolism enzyme of Cirrhinus mrigala (fingerling).
statement: 由于饮食需求随发育阶段而变化，本研究旨在确定日粮蛋白能比对mrigala（鱼种）生长性能、体组成、饲料利用率和氮代谢酶的影响。
text_zh: 由于饮食需求随发育阶段而变化，本研究旨在确定日粮蛋白能比对mrigala（鱼种）生长性能、体组成、饲料利用率和氮代谢酶的影响。
text_en: Since dietary requirements vary with developmental stage, this study aimed to determine the effects of dietary protein-to-energy ratio on the growth performance, body composition, feed utilization, and nitrogen metabolic enzymes of mrigala (fish species).
outcome: 生长性能、体组成、饲料利用率、氮代谢

quote: On the other hand, fish fed with high or low P/E ratio diet (E, 26.50, or A, 17.84) showed lowest growth performance and feed utilization.
statement: 另一方面，饲喂高蛋白/能量比（E, 26.50）或低蛋白/能量比（A, 17.84）饲料的鱼表现出最低的生长性能和饲料利用率。
text_zh: 另一方面，饲喂高蛋白/能量比（E, 26.50）或低蛋白/能量比（A, 17.84）饲料的鱼表现出最低的生长性能和饲料利用率。
text_en: On the other hand, fish fed diets with a high protein/energy ratio (E, 26.50) or a low protein/energy ratio (A, 17.84) showed the lowest growth performance and feed utilization.

quote:
Sá et al. (2014) (Sa et al
2014) reported that low-protein diets are poorly digestible.
statement: 低蛋白日粮的消化率较低。
text_zh: 低蛋白日粮的消化率较低。
text_en: The digestibility of low-protein diets is lower.

quote:
In the present study, the mRNA expression of the NPY and
AgRp genes was significantly affected by the dietary P/E ratio of the experimental diets.
The gene expression level linearly increased with the increasing P/E ratio in the diets.
statement: 在本研究中，实验日粮的蛋白质/能量比显著影响了NPY和AgRP基因的mRNA表达，且基因表达水平随日粮中蛋白质/能量比的增加呈线性增加。
text_zh: 在本研究中，实验日粮的蛋白质/能量比显著影响了NPY和AgRP基因的mRNA表达，且基因表达水平随日粮中蛋白质/能量比的增加呈线性增加。
text_en: In this study, the protein/energy ratio of the experimental diets significantly affected the mRNA expression of NPY and AgRP genes, and gene expression levels increased linearly with an increase in the dietary protein/energy ratio.

quote:
Similarly, in Groups A and B, the protein
level was below the optimal level, which could be the reason for the low feed intake and
acceptability: that is, the feed was low in dietary protein and high in carbohydrates/lipids.
statement: 同样，在A组和B组中，蛋白质水平低于最佳水平，这可能是采食量和适口性低的原因：即饲料中膳食蛋白质低而碳水化合物/脂质高。
text_zh: 同样，在A组和B组中，蛋白质水平低于最佳水平，这可能是采食量和适口性低的原因：即饲料中膳食蛋白质低而碳水化合物/脂质高。
text_en: Similarly, in groups A and B, protein levels were below the optimal level, which may be the reason for low feed intake and palatability: that is, low dietary protein and high carbohydrate/lipid in the feed.
intervention_record: 低蛋白高碳水或脂质日粮

quote:
The protein/energy ratio can affect the growth performance, feed efficiency, and
body composition of fish.
statement: 蛋白质/能量比可以影响鱼类的生长性能、饲料效率和身体组成。
text_zh: 蛋白质/能量比可以影响鱼类的生长性能、饲料效率和身体组成。
text_en: The protein/energy ratio can affect the growth performance, feed efficiency and body composition of fish.

quote:
Lipids and carbohydrates are
excellent sources of non-protein energy for growth and metabolism, but their inclusion
with protein at non-optimal proportions can affect feed consumption and body fat (Cho et
al 2015).
statement: 脂质和碳水化合物是生长和代谢的非蛋白质能量的优良来源，但它们与蛋白质的比例如果不最佳，会影响摄食量和体脂。
text_zh: 脂质和碳水化合物是生长和代谢的非蛋白质能量的优良来源，但它们与蛋白质的比例如果不最佳，会影响摄食量和体脂。
text_en: Lipids and carbohydrates are good sources of non-protein energy for growth and metabolism, but if their ratio to protein is not optimal, it can affect feed intake and body fat.
intervention_record: 非最优蛋白能量比日粮

quote:
Similar to our findings, the results reported by Deng et al. (2011) showed that
high HSI was associated with the protein/carbohydrate level or unsuitable protein/energy
ratio (Deng et al 2011b) in Polydactylus sexfilis.
statement: Deng等人(2011)报道的结果显示，在Polydactylus sexfilis中，高肝体指数(HSI)与蛋白质/碳水化合物水平或不合适的蛋白质/能量比率有关。
text_zh: Deng等人(2011)报道的结果显示，在Polydactylus sexfilis中，高肝体指数(HSI)与蛋白质/碳水化合物水平或不合适的蛋白质/能量比率有关。
text_en: Deng et al. (2011) reported that in Polydactylus sexfilis, a high hepatosomatic index (HSI) was associated with protein/carbohydrate levels or an inappropriate protein/energy ratio.
intervention_record: 非最优蛋白能量比日粮

quote:
Studies have also reported that fish that
were fed diets low in protein experienced glycogen deposition in the liver, resulting in an
increased HSI (Yang et al 2002a; Wu et al 2015b).
statement: 研究还报道，喂食低蛋白日粮的鱼经历了肝脏糖原沉积，导致肝体指数(HSI)增加。
text_zh: 研究还报道，喂食低蛋白日粮的鱼经历了肝脏糖原沉积，导致肝体指数(HSI)增加。
text_en: The study also reported that fish fed low-protein diets experienced hepatic glycogen deposition, leading to an increase in the hepatosomatic index (HSI).

quote:
Feed intake was significantly higher in groups that were fed high P/E ratio diets
compared with those fed low P/E ratio diets.
statement: 与喂食低P/E比日粮的组相比，喂食高P/E比日粮的组的摄食量显著更高。
text_zh: 与喂食低P/E比日粮的组相比，喂食高P/E比日粮的组的摄食量显著更高。
text_en: Feed intake was significantly higher in the group fed a high P/E ratio diet compared to the group fed a low P/E ratio diet.

quote:
Similarly, if a diet is deficient in an essential nutrient, the fish tries to consume more feed
to fulfill the demands for the specific nutrient (Sa et al 2014).
statement: 同样，如果日粮缺乏某种必需营养素，鱼会试图消耗更多饲料以满足对该特定营养素的需求。
text_zh: 同样，如果日粮缺乏某种必需营养素，鱼会试图消耗更多饲料以满足对该特定营养素的需求。
text_en: Similarly, if the diet lacks a certain essential nutrient, fish will try to consume more feed to meet their demand for that specific nutrient.

quote: Fish body VSI is a good indicator of fish health and fish yield production (Jiang et al 2015).
statement: 鱼体内脏指数（VSI）是鱼类健康和产量生产的良好指标。
text_zh: 鱼体内脏指数（VSI）是鱼类健康和产量生产的良好指标。
text_en: The fish visceral somatic index (VSI) is a good indicator of fish health and production yield.

quote: VSI in the present study was higher at both low (group A) and high P/E (group E) ratio of the diets.
statement: 本研究中，在低蛋白/能量比（A组）和高蛋白/能量比（E组）的日粮中，内脏指数（VSI）均较高。
text_zh: 本研究中，在低蛋白/能量比（A组）和高蛋白/能量比（E组）的日粮中，内脏指数（VSI）均较高。
text_en: In this study, the visceral somatic index (VSI) was higher in diets with a low protein/energy ratio (Group A) and a high protein/energy ratio (Group E).
outcome: 内脏脂肪沉积/健康状态

quote: Our result suggests that medium level of P/E ratio gives normal VSI and healthy fish.
statement: 研究结果表明，中等水平的蛋白/能量比能产生正常的内脏指数和健康的鱼。
text_zh: 研究结果表明，中等水平的蛋白/能量比能产生正常的内脏指数和健康的鱼。
text_en: The results indicate that a moderate protein/energy ratio produces normal viscerosomatic index and healthy fish.

quote: The HSI ratio was higher at low P/E ratio than high P/E ratio diets.
statement: 低蛋白/能量比日粮组的肝体指数（HSI）高于高蛋白/能量比日粮组。
text_zh: 低蛋白/能量比日粮组的肝体指数（HSI）高于高蛋白/能量比日粮组。
text_en: The hepatosomatic index (HSI) of the low protein/energy ratio diet group was higher than that of the high protein/energy ratio diet group.

quote: the purpose of our study was to encompass the indirect effect of different dietary protein to energy ratio of bait fish mori diet on growth performance, body composition, nitrogen metabolism and relative AMPK & mTOR pathways gene expression of Chinese perch.
statement: 本研究旨在探讨不同蛋白能量比的饵料鱼糜日粮对鳜鱼生长性能、体组成、氮代谢及AMPK和mTOR通路基因表达的间接影响。
text_zh: 本研究旨在探讨不同蛋白能量比的饵料鱼糜日粮对鳜鱼生长性能、体组成、氮代谢及AMPK和mTOR通路基因表达的间接影响。
text_en: This study aims to investigate the indirect effects of trash fish meal diets with different protein-to-energy ratios on the growth performance, body composition, nitrogen metabolism, and gene expression of the AMPK and mTOR pathways in mandarin fish.

quote: Three Iso-energetic diets (16 kJ/g) were formulated with various P/E ratios (19.79, 22.19 and 24.46 mg protein/kJ), each with protein level (28.18, 31.36, and 33.91 %), were named as A, B, and C.
statement: 配制了三种等能（16 kJ/g）但具有不同蛋白能量比（19.79、22.19和24.46 mg蛋白/kJ）及相应蛋白水平（28.18%、31.36%和33.91%）的日粮，分别命名为A、B和C。
text_zh: 配制了三种等能（16 kJ/g）但具有不同蛋白能量比（19.79、22.19和24.46 mg蛋白/kJ）及相应蛋白水平（28.18%、31.36%和33.91%）的日粮，分别命名为A、B和C。
text_en: Three isoenergetic (16 kJ/g) diets with different protein-to-energy ratios (19.79, 22.19 and 24.46 mg protein/kJ) and corresponding protein levels (28.18%, 31.36% and 33.91%) were formulated and named A, B and C.

quote: Prior to the experimental trial, C. mrigala fingerlings were acclimatized to the trial condition for 15 days.
statement: 实验前，麦瑞加拉鲮鱼苗在试验条件下驯化了15天。
text_zh: 实验前，麦瑞加拉鲮鱼苗在试验条件下驯化了15天。
text_en: Before the experiment, Cirrhinus mrigala fry were acclimated to the experimental conditions for 15 days.

quote: During this time, commercial diet was fed two times a day at 08:00 am and 4:00 pm with 4% of wet body weight.
statement: 在驯化期间，每天上午8点和下午4点按湿体重的4%投喂商业饲料两次。
text_zh: 在驯化期间，每天上午8点和下午4点按湿体重的4%投喂商业饲料两次。
text_en: During the acclimation period, commercial feed was fed twice daily at 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM at 4% of wet body weight.

quote: After an acclimatization period, fingerlings were starved for 24 h, and weighed on a digital balance.
statement: 驯化期结束后，鱼苗禁食24小时，并在电子天平上称重。
text_zh: 驯化期结束后，鱼苗禁食24小时，并在电子天平上称重。
text_en: After the acclimation period ended, the fry were fasted for 24 hours and weighed on an electronic balance.

quote: Fingerlings of the same size (17.8±0.12 g) were randomly distributed into five groups in triplicates. Each group contained 60 fishes (20 fish per tank) in 350 L fiberglass water tanks with flow-through water system.
statement: 相同规格（17.8±0.12克）的鱼苗被随机分为五组，每组三个重复，每箱20尾鱼置于350升玻璃钢水箱中，采用流水系统。
text_zh: 相同规格（17.8±0.12克）的鱼苗被随机分为五组，每组三个重复，每箱20尾鱼置于350升玻璃钢水箱中，采用流水系统。
text_en: Fish fry of the same specification (17.8±0.12 g) were randomly divided into five groups, with three replicates per group, and 20 fish per tank placed in 350-liter fiberglass reinforced plastic tanks using a flow-through system.
intervention: High-density group rearing in flow-through system
intervention_record: 高密度分组饲养与流水系统
outcome: stocking density (放养密度) 与水环境

quote: Each group was hand-fed twice a day at 08:00 am and 4:00 pm at 4% wet body weight for 8 weeks.
statement: 各组在8周内每天上午8点和下午4点按湿体重的4%人工投喂两次。
text_zh: 各组在8周内每天上午8点和下午4点按湿体重的4%人工投喂两次。
text_en: Each group was manually fed twice daily at 8 a.m. and 4 p.m. over 8 weeks, at 4% of wet body weight.

quote: Uneaten food was collected by siphon after 30 min of feeding, then desiccated at 105 °C for 2 h, and weighed to calculate the feed consumption.
statement: 投喂30分钟后通过虹吸收集残饵，在105°C下干燥2小时后称重以计算摄食量。
text_zh: 投喂30分钟后通过虹吸收集残饵，在105°C下干燥2小时后称重以计算摄食量。
text_en: Feed leftovers were collected by siphoning 30 minutes after feeding, dried at 105°C for 2 hours, and weighed to calculate feed intake.

quote: Water conditions were maintained within the tanks by well-aerated flow-through system.
statement: 通过充分曝气的流水系统维持水箱内的水质条件。
text_zh: 通过充分曝气的流水系统维持水箱内的水质条件。
text_en: Water quality conditions in the tanks are maintained by a flow-through system with sufficient aeration.

quote: The optimum protein/energy ratios have been conducted in numerous farm fish species, such as Persian sturgeon (Mohseni et al 2013a); Japanese eel (Okorie et al 2007); Olive flounder (Kim et al 2005) and Korean rockfish (Kim et al 2004).
statement: 已有研究在波斯鲟、日本鳗、大菱鲆和韩国石斑鱼等多种养殖鱼类中进行了最佳蛋白/能量比的测定。
text_zh: 已有研究在波斯鲟、日本鳗、大菱鲆和韩国石斑鱼等多种养殖鱼类中进行了最佳蛋白/能量比的测定。
text_en: Existing studies have determined the optimal protein/energy ratio in various farmed fish species, including Persian sturgeon, Japanese eel, turbot, and Korean grouper.

population.species: 波斯鲟; 日本鳗; 大菱鲆; 韩国石斑鱼

quote: Prior to the start of experiment, fish were acclimatized for two weeks to the experimental condition, during this period fish were fed twice a day at 4 % wet body weight (08:00, and 16:00) with a commercial diet.
statement: 实验前，鱼在实验条件下适应两周，期间每天两次（08:00和16:00）按湿体重4%投喂商业饲料。
text_zh: 实验前，鱼在实验条件下适应两周，期间每天两次（08:00和16:00）按湿体重4%投喂商业饲料。
text_en: Before the experiment, fish were acclimated to experimental conditions for two weeks, during which they were fed commercial feed twice daily (at 08:00 and 16:00) at 4% of wet body weight.

quote: At the start of the experiment, fish were starved for 24 h and weighed.
statement: 实验开始时，鱼被禁食24小时并称重。
text_zh: 实验开始时，鱼被禁食24小时并称重。
text_en: At the start of the experiment, fish were fasted for 24 hours and weighed.

quote: The imbalance diet with high protein ratio will cause an increase of protein catabolism for energy demand instead of fish growth.
statement: 高蛋白比例的不平衡饮食会导致蛋白质分解代谢增加以满足能量需求，而不是用于鱼类生长。
text_zh: 高蛋白比例的不平衡饮食会导致蛋白质分解代谢增加以满足能量需求，而不是用于鱼类生长。
text_en: An unbalanced diet with a high protein ratio leads to increased protein catabolism to meet energy requirements, rather than being used for fish growth.

quote: Similarly with low protein to high energy ratio diet will cause decline of feed consumption, which will lead to decrease in the essential nutrients and protein for proper growth proliferation (Shah Alam et al 2008).
statement: 低蛋白高能量比的饮食会导致饲料摄入量下降，进而导致必需营养素和蛋白质减少，影响正常的生长增殖。
text_zh: 低蛋白高能量比的饮食会导致饲料摄入量下降，进而导致必需营养素和蛋白质减少，影响正常的生长增殖。
text_en: Diets with a low protein-to-energy ratio lead to decreased feed intake, which in turn reduces essential nutrients and protein, affecting normal growth and reproduction.

quote: High protein diets increase growth rate of aquaculture species, thereby oxidative metabolism surge, and by the synthesis of protein consequently of amino acids surplus (Houlihan et al 1993).
statement: 高蛋白饮食会增加养殖物种的生长率，从而导致氧化代谢激增，并因蛋白质合成而产生氨基酸过剩。
text_zh: 高蛋白饮食会增加养殖物种的生长率，从而导致氧化代谢激增，并因蛋白质合成而产生氨基酸过剩。
text_en: High-protein diets increase the growth rate of farmed species, leading to a surge in oxidative metabolism and an excess of amino acids due to protein synthesis.
outcome: 生长率与氧化代谢压力

quote: Fish health and nutritional status can be modulated by amending the key enzymes involve in intermediary metabolism (Metón et al 1999a; Metón 2003; Melo et al 2006a).
statement: 通过调节参与中间代谢的关键酶，可以调节鱼类的健康和营养状况。
text_zh: 通过调节参与中间代谢的关键酶，可以调节鱼类的健康和营养状况。
text_en: By regulating key enzymes involved in intermediate metabolism, the health and nutritional status of fish can be regulated.

quote:
In the present study, the increasing trend of liver AST, ALT and GDH activities in
with increasing dietary P/E ratio, may signal the excess carbon backbones of amino acids
usage to stream energy demands.
statement: 本研究中，随着饲料蛋白/能量比（P/E）的增加，肝脏AST、ALT和GDH活性呈上升趋势，这可能表明氨基酸碳骨架被过度用于满足能量需求。
text_zh: 本研究中，随着饲料蛋白/能量比（P/E）的增加，肝脏AST、ALT和GDH活性呈上升趋势，这可能表明氨基酸碳骨架被过度用于满足能量需求。
text_en: In this study, as the dietary protein/energy ratio (P/E) increased, liver AST, ALT and GDH activities showed an upward trend, which may indicate that amino acid carbon skeletons were excessively used to meet energy demands.
outcome: 肝脏酶活性与氨基酸代谢

quote:
Similar, results were reported in other fish species,
GDH, ALT, and AST in Oncorhynchus mykiss (Sánchez-Muros et al 1998a; Melo et al
2006b) AST and ALT in R. quelen , (Melo et al 2006b) and GDH in Sparus aurata
(Metón et al 1999b).
statement: 在其他鱼类物种中也报道了类似的结果，包括虹鳟、R. quelen和鲷鱼的GDH、ALT和AST变化。
text_zh: 在其他鱼类物种中也报道了类似的结果，包括虹鳟、R. quelen和鲷鱼的GDH、ALT和AST变化。
text_en: Similar results have been reported in other fish species, including changes in GDH, ALT and AST in rainbow trout, R. quelen and sea bream.

population.species: Oncorhynchus mykiss, R. quelen, Sparus aurata

quote:
This indicate that, when dietary P/E ratio is higher than optimal, the
quality of muscle can be affected.
statement: 这表明，当饲料蛋白/能量比高于最佳值时，肌肉质量可能会受到影响。
text_zh: 这表明，当饲料蛋白/能量比高于最佳值时，肌肉质量可能会受到影响。
text_en: This indicates that muscle quality may be affected when the dietary protein/energy ratio is higher than the optimal value.

quote: Liver ALT and AST activities showed a significantly increasing trend with the increasing P/E ratio from low to high.
statement: 肝脏ALT和AST活性随着P/E比从低到高呈显著增加趋势。
text_zh: 肝脏ALT和AST活性随着P/E比从低到高呈显著增加趋势。
text_en: Liver ALT and AST activities showed a significant increasing trend as the P/E ratio increased from low to high.
outcome: 肝脏酶活性（氮代谢指标）

quote: However, the lipid contents of the whole body, muscle, and liver were significantly higher in Groups A (low P/E ratio) and E (high P/E ratio).
statement: 然而，A组（低P/E比）和E组（高P/E比）的全身、肌肉和肝脏脂质含量显著较高。
text_zh: 然而，A组（低P/E比）和E组（高P/E比）的全身、肌肉和肝脏脂质含量显著较高。
text_en: However, the whole-body, muscle, and liver lipid contents were significantly higher in Group A (low P/E ratio) and Group E (high P/E ratio).

quote: Similar results were also reported in, olive flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus) (Kim et al 2002b), Zacco barbata (Shyong et al 1998), silver perch (Bidyanus bidyanu) (Yang et al 2002a), and in black sea bream (Sparus macrocephalus) (Zhang et al 2010).
statement: 在橄榄鲆、Zacco barbata、银鲈和黑鲷中也报道了类似的结果。
text_zh: 在橄榄鲆、Zacco barbata、银鲈和黑鲷中也报道了类似的结果。
text_en: Similar results were also reported in olive flounder, Zacco barbata, silver perch and black seabream.

population.species: olive flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus), Zacco barbata, silver perch (Bidyanus bidyanu), black sea bream (Sparus macrocephalus)

quote: In the present study, WG, SGR, PER were increased with increasing dietary P/E ratios from 17.84 to 22.19 mg/kJ, after that it decreased with further increase in dietary P/E ratio, which showed a plateaued at 22.19 mg/kJ (P/E).
statement: 在本研究中，随着日粮蛋白/能量比从17.84增加到22.19 mg/kJ，增重率、特定生长率和蛋白质效率增加；此后，随着日粮蛋白/能量比的进一步增加，这些指标下降，并在22.19 mg/kJ处呈现平台期。
text_zh: 在本研究中，随着日粮蛋白/能量比从17.84增加到22.19 mg/kJ，增重率、特定生长率和蛋白质效率增加；此后，随着日粮蛋白/能量比的进一步增加，这些指标下降，并在22.19 mg/kJ处呈现平台期。
text_en: In this study, as the dietary protein/energy ratio increased from 17.84 to 22.19 mg/kJ, weight gain rate, specific growth rate, and protein efficiency increased; thereafter, with further increases in the dietary protein/energy ratio, these indicators decreased and showed a plateau at 22.19 mg/kJ.

quote: In some fish species, feeding with high P/E ratios showed a growth depression (Papaparaskeva-Papoutsoglou and Alexis 1986; Kalla et al 2003), the reason could be the imbalanced non-protein energy source in fish diet or the high dietary protein inhibitory impact on the digestive enzyme activities (Jana et al 2006).
statement: 在某些鱼类中，饲喂高蛋白/能量比显示出生长抑制，原因可能是鱼日粮中非蛋白质能量源不平衡或高日粮蛋白对消化酶活性的抑制影响。
text_zh: 在某些鱼类中，饲喂高蛋白/能量比显示出生长抑制，原因可能是鱼日粮中非蛋白质能量源不平衡或高日粮蛋白对消化酶活性的抑制影响。
text_en: In some fish species, feeding a high protein/energy ratio showed growth inhibition, possibly due to an imbalance of non-protein energy sources in the fish diet or the inhibitory effect of high dietary protein on digestive enzyme activity.

quote: The feed intake (FI) was significantly higher in group A as compared to both group B and C.
statement: A组的摄食量显著高于B组和C组。
text_zh: A组的摄食量显著高于B组和C组。
text_en: The feed intake of Group A was significantly higher than that of Groups B and C.

quote: Additionally, the intraperitoneal fat (IPF), VSI, and HSI ratios were significantly higher in group A as compare to both groups.
statement: A组的腹腔脂肪、内脏体指数和肝体指数比率显著高于其他两组。
text_zh: A组的腹腔脂肪、内脏体指数和肝体指数比率显著高于其他两组。
text_en: The abdominal fat, viscerosomatic index and hepatosomatic index ratios of Group A were significantly higher than those of the other two groups.
outcome: 生理指标（脂肪沉积与器官指数）

quote: Chinese perch feeds on live fish (Chiang 1959) preferably on (C. mrigala, L. rohita, C. molitorella, and silver carp) (Wu 1988; Liang et al 1998).
statement: 鳜鱼以活鱼为食，偏好摄食特定种类的饵料鱼。
text_zh: 鳜鱼以活鱼为食，偏好摄食特定种类的饵料鱼。
text_en: Mandarin fish feed on live fish and prefer to consume specific types of baitfish.

quote: Therefore, the optimization of dietary requirement for Chinese perch is an urgent demand from aquaculture sector (Liu et al 2017).
statement: 优化鳜鱼的饲料需求是水产养殖行业的迫切需求。
text_zh: 优化鳜鱼的饲料需求是水产养殖行业的迫切需求。
text_en: Optimizing the feed requirements of mandarin fish is an urgent need for the aquaculture industry.

quote: These two-factors could expressively affect growth, feed intake, feed conversion ratio, body composition and metabolism of fish.
statement: 这两个因素（蛋白水平和非蛋白源比例）能显著影响鱼类的生长、采食量、饲料转化率、体组成和代谢。
text_zh: 这两个因素（蛋白水平和非蛋白源比例）能显著影响鱼类的生长、采食量、饲料转化率、体组成和代谢。
text_en: These two factors (protein level and non-protein source ratio) can significantly affect fish growth, feed intake, feed conversion ratio, body composition, and metabolism.
intervention: Adjusting protein and non-protein source ratio
intervention_record: 调整蛋白与非蛋白源比例

quote: Ammonia is lethal for most animals including fish.
statement: 氨对包括鱼在内的大多数动物具有致死性。
text_zh: 氨对包括鱼在内的大多数动物具有致死性。
text_en: Ammonia is lethal to most animals, including fish.

quote: The evolution and assessment of transaminases and deaminases enzymes activities considered a useful tool in the evolution of feeding status of fish (Papaparaskeva-Papoutsoglou and Alexis 1986; Moyano et al 1991a).
statement: 转氨酶和脱氨酶活性的演变和评估被认为是评估鱼类摄食状态的有用工具。
text_zh: 转氨酶和脱氨酶活性的演变和评估被认为是评估鱼类摄食状态的有用工具。
text_en: The evolution and assessment of transaminase and deaminase activities are considered useful tools for evaluating the feeding status of fish.
intervention_record: 转氨酶脱氨酶活性测定

quote: The liver ALT and AST activity in group A was Significantly lower than both group B and C, while, there was no significance difference observed in the activity of these enzymes in both group B and C.
statement: A组肝脏ALT和AST活性显著低于B组和C组，而B组和C组之间这些酶的活性无显著差异。
text_zh: A组肝脏ALT和AST活性显著低于B组和C组，而B组和C组之间这些酶的活性无显著差异。
text_en: Liver ALT and AST activities in Group A were significantly lower than those in Groups B and C, while there was no significant difference in the activities of these enzymes between Groups B and C.

quote: Similarly, almost same trend was observed for liver GDH activity and muscle AMPD activity.
statement: 肝脏GDH活性和肌肉AMPD活性也观察到几乎相同的趋势。
text_zh: 肝脏GDH活性和肌肉AMPD活性也观察到几乎相同的趋势。
text_en: Almost the same trend was also observed for liver GDH activity and muscle AMPD activity.

quote: The water temperature was sustained at 25 ± 0.8 °C.
statement: 水温维持在25 ± 0.8 °C。
text_zh: 水温维持在25 ± 0.8 °C。
text_en: Water temperature was maintained at 25 ± 0.8 °C.

quote:
During the experimental
period, the pH value was 7.82 ± 0.25, the dissolved oxygen (DO) content was
approximately 7 mg/L, the total ammonia content was about 0.17 ± 0.02 mg/L.
statement: 实验期间，pH值为7.82 ± 0.25，溶解氧含量约为7 mg/L，总氨氮含量约为0.17 ± 0.02 mg/L。
text_zh: 实验期间，pH值为7.82 ± 0.25，溶解氧含量约为7 mg/L，总氨氮含量约为0.17 ± 0.02 mg/L。
text_en: During the experimental period, pH was 7.82 ± 0.25, dissolved oxygen content was about 7 mg/L, and total ammonia nitrogen content was about 0.17 ± 0.02 mg/L.

quote:
For fish sample collection, experimental protocols of Institutional Animal Care and
Institute of Huazhong Agricultural University Ethical code (Ethical Approval No.
HBAC20091138: dated, 15/11/2009) were strictly followed.
statement: 鱼类样本采集严格遵循华中农业大学机构动物护理与伦理委员会的实验方案（伦理批准号：HBAC20091138）。
text_zh: 鱼类样本采集严格遵循华中农业大学机构动物护理与伦理委员会的实验方案（伦理批准号：HBAC20091138）。
text_en: Fish sample collection strictly followed the experimental protocol of the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee of Huazhong Agricultural University (Ethical Approval Number: HBAC20091138).

quote:
At the termination of feeding
trail, last feeding was done 24 hours before sample collection, C. mrigala were
anaesthetized with MS-222, and weighted in bulk for growth performance.
statement: 在饲养试验结束时，最后一次喂食在采样前24小时进行，C. mrigala使用MS-222麻醉并称重以评估生长性能。
text_zh: 在饲养试验结束时，最后一次喂食在采样前24小时进行，C. mrigala使用MS-222麻醉并称重以评估生长性能。
text_en: At the end of the feeding trial, the last feeding was performed 24 hours before sampling, and C. mrigala were anesthetized with MS-222 and weighed to assess growth performance.

quote:
Similarly, Chinese perch
were anaesthetized with MS-222 (tricaine methane-sulfonate) with 75mg/L, and weighed.
statement: 同样地，鳜鱼使用75mg/L的MS-222（三卡因甲磺酸盐）进行麻醉并称重。
text_zh: 同样地，鳜鱼使用75mg/L的MS-222（三卡因甲磺酸盐）进行麻醉并称重。
text_en: Similarly, mandarin fish were anesthetized with 75 mg/L of MS-222 (tricaine methanesulfonate) and weighed.

quote: Bait fish, weight gain and specific growth rate (SGR) was significantly lower in group A as compared to other groups.
statement: 饵料鱼在A组的体重增加和特定生长率显著低于其他组。
text_zh: 饵料鱼在A组的体重增加和特定生长率显著低于其他组。
text_en: The weight gain and specific growth rate of bait fish in Group A were significantly lower than those in the other groups.

quote: While the FCR was significantly higher in group A than group B and C, and there was no significant difference among both group B and C.
statement: A组的饲料转化率（FCR）显著高于B组和C组，且B组和C组之间无显著差异。
text_zh: A组的饲料转化率（FCR）显著高于B组和C组，且B组和C组之间无显著差异。
text_en: The feed conversion ratio (FCR) of Group A was significantly higher than that of Group B and Group C, and there was no significant difference between Group B and Group C.

quote: Chinese perch in group B and C showed better growth performance and nutrient utilization than group A, which was further confirmed by the higher protein efficiency ratio (PER) and specific growth rate (SGR) of these two groups.
statement: B组和C组的鳜鱼表现出比A组更好的生长性能和营养利用率，这由这两个组较高的蛋白质效率比（PER）和特定生长率（SGR）进一步证实。
text_zh: B组和C组的鳜鱼表现出比A组更好的生长性能和营养利用率，这由这两个组较高的蛋白质效率比（PER）和特定生长率（SGR）进一步证实。
text_en: Group B and Group C mandarin fish showed better growth performance and nutrient utilization than Group A, further confirmed by the higher protein efficiency ratio (PER) and specific growth rate (SGR) in these two groups.

quote: In the current experiment, whole body composition and muscle tissues were influenced by the dietary P/E ratios.
statement: 在本实验中，全身成分和肌肉组织受到膳食蛋白能量比（P/E ratios）的影响。
text_zh: 在本实验中，全身成分和肌肉组织受到膳食蛋白能量比（P/E ratios）的影响。
text_en: In this experiment, whole-body composition and muscle tissue were affected by dietary protein-to-energy ratios (P/E ratios).

quote: Padmavathi (2012) (Padmavathi et al 2012) applied Nitrosomonas and Nitrobacter in different fish ponds, the results showed that probiotics played a major role in maintaining optimum water quality parameters especially dissolved oxygen, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate and phosphates throughout the culture period.
statement: Padmavathi在不同的鱼塘中应用了亚硝化单胞菌和硝化杆菌，结果显示益生菌在整个养殖期间在维持最佳水质参数（特别是溶解氧、氨、亚硝酸盐、硝酸盐和磷酸盐）方面发挥了主要作用。
text_zh: Padmavathi在不同的鱼塘中应用了亚硝化单胞菌和硝化杆菌，结果显示益生菌在整个养殖期间在维持最佳水质参数（特别是溶解氧、氨、亚硝酸盐、硝酸盐和磷酸盐）方面发挥了主要作用。
text_en: Padmavathi applied Nitrosomonas and Nitrobacter in different fish ponds, and the results showed that probiotics played a major role in maintaining optimal water quality parameters (particularly dissolved oxygen, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, and phosphate) throughout the rearing period.
outcome: 水质参数（溶解氧、氨氮等）

quote: In the present study, nitrobacteria and PSB were applied in intensive cultured pond of Chinese perch, respectively, to probe into the impact of microbial probiotics in situ treatment on water environment in high nitrogen and phosphorus concentration pond.
statement: 本研究分别在鳜鱼高密度养殖池塘中应用硝化细菌和光合细菌，以探讨微生物益生菌原位处理对高氮磷浓度池塘水环境的影响。
text_zh: 本研究分别在鳜鱼高密度养殖池塘中应用硝化细菌和光合细菌，以探讨微生物益生菌原位处理对高氮磷浓度池塘水环境的影响。
text_en: This study applied nitrifying bacteria and photosynthetic bacteria in high-density aquaculture ponds of mandarin fish to investigate the effects of in situ treatment with microbial probiotics on pond water environments with high nitrogen and phosphorus concentrations.

quote: Similarly, in the present study the bait fishes in group C, WG and SGR, was not significantly different than group B which was also reported by Jauncey (Jauncey 1982) that, in some species when the dietary protein requirement increased, the impact on growth was same or even decreased.
statement: 本研究中C组饵鱼的增重和特定生长率与B组无显著差异，这与Jauncey报道的某些物种在膳食蛋白需求增加时生长影响相同甚至下降的情况一致。
text_zh: 本研究中C组饵鱼的增重和特定生长率与B组无显著差异，这与Jauncey报道的某些物种在膳食蛋白需求增加时生长影响相同甚至下降的情况一致。
text_en: In this study, there was no significant difference in weight gain and specific growth rate between the bait fish of Group C and Group B.
